nodes.label: Set Theory
nodes.summary: ZFC axioms — the foundational language in which modern mathematics is formalized.

nodes.label: Logic & Proof
nodes.summary: Formal deduction: what it means for a statement to follow from axioms.

nodes.label: Number Theory
nodes.summary: The deep structure of the integers — primes, divisibility, Diophantine equations.

nodes.label: Linear Algebra
nodes.summary: Vector spaces and linear maps — the computational backbone of science and ML.

nodes.label: Calculus & Analysis
nodes.summary: Limits, derivatives, integrals — the mathematics of continuous change.

nodes.label: Probability Theory
nodes.summary: Kolmogorov's axioms — rigorous reasoning under uncertainty.

nodes.label: Group Theory
nodes.summary: The mathematics of symmetry — foundational to physics and cryptography.

nodes.label: Topology
nodes.summary: Properties preserved under continuous deformation — shape without distance.

nodes.label: Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems
nodes.summary: Any consistent formal system rich enough for arithmetic contains true statements it cannot prove.

nodes.label: Riemann Hypothesis
nodes.summary: Do all non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function lie on the critical line Re(s)=1/2? Success: a proof or disproof. Unsolved since 1859; a Clay Millennium Problem.

nodes.label: P versus NP
nodes.summary: Can every problem whose solution is quickly verifiable also be quickly solved? Success: proof that P=NP or P≠NP. A Clay Millennium Problem; foundational to computation and cryptography.

nodes.label: Classical Mechanics
nodes.summary: Newtonian and Lagrangian dynamics — motion of matter under forces.

nodes.label: Thermodynamics
nodes.summary: Energy, entropy, and the arrow of time — the laws heat and work obey.

nodes.label: Electromagnetism
nodes.summary: Maxwell's unification of electricity, magnetism, and light.

nodes.label: Special Relativity
nodes.summary: Spacetime, the constancy of light speed, mass-energy equivalence.

nodes.label: General Relativity
nodes.summary: Gravity as the curvature of spacetime by mass-energy.

nodes.label: Quantum Mechanics
nodes.summary: The probabilistic laws governing matter and energy at atomic scale.

nodes.label: Standard Model
nodes.summary: The field theory of all known particles and three of the four forces.

nodes.label: Big Bang Cosmology
nodes.summary: The universe's expansion from a hot dense state ~13.8 billion years ago.

nodes.label: Higgs Boson Detection (2012)
nodes.summary: ATLAS and CMS at the LHC confirmed the Higgs boson, completing the Standard Model's particle roster.

nodes.label: Gravitational Waves (GW150914)
nodes.summary: LIGO's 2015 detection of merging black holes directly confirmed a century-old prediction of general relativity.

nodes.label: Quantum Gravity
nodes.summary: How are general relativity and quantum mechanics reconciled into one theory? Success: an experimentally testable framework unifying gravity with the quantum. The central open problem of fundamental physics.

nodes.label: Dark Matter & Dark Energy
nodes.summary: What are the ~95% of the universe's mass-energy that is neither ordinary matter nor radiation? Success: identification and characterization of the dark sector.

nodes.label: Evolution by Natural Selection
nodes.summary: Descent with modification under selection — the organizing principle of all biology.

refs.note: Darwin, On the Origin of Species

nodes.label: Molecular Biology
nodes.summary: The central dogma — DNA to RNA to protein — and the machinery of the cell.

nodes.label: Genetics & Genomics
nodes.summary: Heredity, variation, and the readout of genomes.

nodes.label: Cell Biology
nodes.summary: The cell as the fundamental unit of life — its structures and processes.

nodes.label: Neuroscience
nodes.summary: How nervous systems process information and produce behavior.

nodes.label: Ecology
nodes.summary: Interactions among organisms and their environment; systems at population and biosphere scale.

nodes.label: DNA Double Helix (1953)
nodes.summary: Watson, Crick, Franklin, and Wilkins established DNA's structure, revealing the mechanism of heredity.

nodes.label: Human Genome Project (2003)
nodes.summary: The first essentially complete sequence of the human genome, foundational to modern genomics and medicine.

nodes.label: Origin of Life
nodes.summary: How did non-living chemistry give rise to self-replicating life on early Earth? Success: a demonstrated, plausible abiogenesis pathway. Constrained by prebiotic chemistry and the RNA-world hypothesis.

nodes.label: The Nature of Consciousness
nodes.summary: How and why does subjective experience arise from physical processes (the 'hard problem')? Success: a theory that predicts and explains the presence and content of experience. Deeply contested across neuroscience and philosophy.

nodes.label: Computability & Turing Machines
nodes.summary: What can in principle be computed — the Church-Turing thesis and its limits.

nodes.label: Computational Complexity
nodes.summary: How resource cost scales with problem size — P, NP, and the hierarchy.

nodes.label: Algorithms & Data Structures
nodes.summary: Systematic procedures and the structures that make them efficient.

nodes.label: Information Theory
nodes.summary: Shannon entropy, compression, channel capacity — the math beneath all communication and cognition.

nodes.label: Machine Learning
nodes.summary: Systems that improve at a task from data rather than explicit programming.

nodes.label: Deep Learning
nodes.summary: Representation learning with deep neural networks — the engine of the modern AI era.

nodes.label: Transformer Architecture
nodes.summary: Attention-based sequence models — the substrate of large language models.

nodes.label: AlphaFold Protein Structure (2021)
nodes.summary: DeepMind's system predicted protein 3D structure from sequence at near-experimental accuracy, a landmark in scientific ML (CASP14).

nodes.label: Artificial General Intelligence
nodes.summary: Can we build systems that match or exceed human intelligence across the full range of cognitive tasks — and do so safely and controllably? Success criteria and safety framing are themselves active research.

nodes.label: AI Alignment
nodes.summary: How do we ensure advanced AI systems reliably pursue intended goals and remain correctable? Success: robust, scalable methods for oversight and value alignment. Load-bearing for the safe development of powerful AI.

nodes.label: Chemistry
nodes.summary: How atoms bond and react — the science of matter's transformations.

nodes.label: Quantum Chemistry
nodes.summary: Chemical bonding and reactivity derived from quantum mechanics.

nodes.label: Materials Science
nodes.summary: Structure-property relationships that let us design matter for a purpose.

nodes.label: Energy & Thermodynamics
nodes.summary: Conservation, conversion, and the entropy cost of every energy transformation.

nodes.label: Nuclear Physics
nodes.summary: The structure of the nucleus — fission, fusion, and radioactive decay.

nodes.label: Fusion Ignition at NIF (2022)
nodes.summary: The National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition — more energy out of the fuel than the laser energy delivered to it — a scientific first.

nodes.label: Room-Temperature Superconductivity
nodes.summary: Can a material superconduct at ambient temperature and pressure? Success: a reproducible, independently verified ambient superconductor. Would transform energy transmission and computing.

nodes.label: Grid-Scale Clean Energy Storage
nodes.summary: How do we store renewable energy cheaply and durably at civilizational scale? Success: storage economics that make an all-renewable grid reliable. An engineering-and-materials frontier with direct climate leverage.

nodes.label: Information Theory
nodes.summary: Shannon entropy, compression, channel capacity — the math beneath all communication and cognition.

nodes.label: Distributed Systems
nodes.summary: Consensus, fault tolerance, CAP theorem — how components coordinate at scale.

nodes.label: Agent Orchestration
nodes.summary: Multi-agent coordination, task routing, and emergent collective behavior.

nodes.label: Context & Memory Design
nodes.summary: Working memory, long-term vaults, retrieval-augmented generation, and state across sessions.

nodes.label: System Decomposition
nodes.summary: Break complex problems into composable, independently testable modules.

nodes.label: Prompt & Tool Design
nodes.summary: Craft system prompts, tool schemas, and MCP server contracts that are robust under adversarial inputs.

nodes.label: Evaluation & Attestation
nodes.summary: Design eval harnesses, red-team prompts, and attestation flows that verify claims automatically.

nodes.label: Retrieval Architecture
nodes.summary: Vector + graph stores, hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, and query decomposition.

nodes.label: Building MCP Servers
nodes.summary: Regularly shipping Model Context Protocol servers that expose tools to agents.

nodes.label: Working Multi-Agent System
nodes.summary: A working multi-agent system with a memory layer and an eval suite — the Stage 1 build artifact.

nodes.label: Open-Source MCP Server
nodes.summary: An MCP server or reusable agent pattern published openly for others to build on.

nodes.label: Reliable Agent Autonomy
nodes.summary: Open problem: how do agents maintain reliable, auditable autonomy over long horizons without drift?

nodes.label: Orbital Mechanics
nodes.summary: Kepler's laws, delta-v, Hohmann transfers — the geometry of getting from A to B in space.

nodes.label: Propulsion & Thermodynamics
nodes.summary: Specific impulse, rocket equation, thermal management — the physics of thrust.

nodes.label: Materials Science
nodes.summary: Stress, fatigue, radiation hardening — choosing materials that survive the environment.

nodes.label: Control Theory
nodes.summary: PID controllers, state-space models, Kalman filters — keeping systems on trajectory.

nodes.label: Trajectory Modeling
nodes.summary: Model mission profiles, compute delta-v budgets, verify with simulation.

nodes.label: Systems Engineering
nodes.summary: Requirements flow-down, interface control, verification and validation across subsystems.

nodes.label: Simulation & Telemetry
nodes.summary: Build and run physics simulations; instrument systems to produce verifiable telemetry.

nodes.label: Verified Mission Profile
nodes.summary: A simulated mission profile with a verified delta-v budget — the Stage 1 build artifact.

nodes.label: Open Simulation / Hardware Design
nodes.summary: A reproducible simulation or open hardware design published for the community.

nodes.label: Low-Cost Launch to Orbit
nodes.summary: Open problem: reach orbit reliably for under $1k/kg payload mass.

nodes.label: Molecular Biology
nodes.summary: DNA, RNA, proteins — the central dogma and the molecular machinery of life.

nodes.label: Genetics & the Genome
nodes.summary: Inheritance, variation, CRISPR, pangenomes — reading and editing the blueprint.

nodes.label: Neuroscience
nodes.summary: Neural circuits, synaptic plasticity, cognition — how the brain computes.

nodes.label: Systems Physiology
nodes.summary: Feedback loops, homeostasis, organ systems — the body as a control system.

nodes.label: Experimental Design
nodes.summary: Controls, power analysis, blinding, pre-registration — how to generate trustworthy evidence.

nodes.label: Bioinformatics
nodes.summary: Sequence alignment, variant calling, single-cell analysis — computational biology in practice.

nodes.label: Statistical Inference
nodes.summary: Bayesian and frequentist methods, multiple testing correction, effect size estimation.

nodes.label: Reproducible Analysis Notebook
nodes.summary: A fully reproducible analysis notebook over an open dataset — the Stage 1 build artifact.

nodes.label: Open Dataset or Validated Method
nodes.summary: A shared dataset, method, or validated visual explainer others can build on.

nodes.label: Longevity Escape Velocity
nodes.summary: Open problem: extend healthy lifespan faster than aging progresses. What's the critical path?

nodes.label: Audience & Distribution
nodes.summary: Algorithms, platforms, network effects — how content reaches and compounds an audience.

nodes.label: Product & Pricing
nodes.summary: Value capture, willingness to pay, tiering — turning capability into something people buy.

nodes.label: Narrative & Brand
nodes.summary: Positioning, voice, signal vs. noise — the difference between content and a body of work.

nodes.label: Unit Economics
nodes.summary: CAC, LTV, contribution margin — the math that determines if the business can scale.

nodes.label: Content Engineering
nodes.summary: Systematic content production: hooks, structure, cadence, repurposing across platforms.

nodes.label: Offer Design
nodes.summary: Package value into offers people feel compelled to buy — positioning, framing, pricing.

nodes.label: Funnel & Analytics
nodes.summary: Build measurement systems that show where the funnel leaks and what to fix.

nodes.label: Shipping Cadence
nodes.summary: The discipline of consistent, fast iteration — weekly shipping beats monthly planning.

nodes.label: Daily Content Loop
nodes.summary: Creating, publishing, and analyzing content as a daily practice — not a campaign.

nodes.label: Shipped Product with Revenue
nodes.summary: A shipped product with its first real revenue — the Stage 1 build artifact.

nodes.label: Open Template or Playbook
nodes.summary: A template, playbook, or teardown published openly for others to adapt.

nodes.label: AI-Native Product Category
nodes.summary: Open problem: what product categories become possible only with AI — and how do you build the first one?
